id: W:gomes|historia historiografia e cultura politica no brasil
original_title: História, historiografia e cultura política no Brasil: algumas reflexões
container: Rachel Soihet, Maria Fernanda Baptista Bicalho and Maria de Fátima Silva Gouvêa (eds.), Culturas políticas: ensaios de história cultural, história política e ensino de história. Rio de Janeiro: Mauad/FAPERJ, 2005, pp. 21–44.
note: The NUPEHC contents list names Gomes and this chapter. ISBN and LC 2006338789 identify its container, not a separate Gomes work. No chapter DOI or separate publisher page established.

The displaced title plus Estampa/Lisbon/1998 imprint identifies Para uma história cultural, Ana Moura’s Portuguese translation of this collection edited by Jean-Pierre Rioux and Jean-François Sirinelli. Identifier is the French original; no graph candidate supplied.

container: Roberto Schwarz, Ao vencedor as batatas: forma literária e processo social nos inícios do romance brasileiro. São Paulo: Duas Cidades/Editora 34, 2000, opening essay.
note: Publisher explicitly identifies the cited essay as the book’s opening text. ISBN identifies the container. Portuguese publication was in Estudos Cebrap 3 (1973); the previously supplied DOI identifies its differently titled French version of 1972.

original_title: Belém do Pará: estudo de geografia urbana
note: Identified two-volume UFPA book, based on the 1966 USP thesis. The catalogue supplies only OCLC 949145025; no LCCN or ISBN found after catalogue searches and the local LC retrospective check. No checkable identifier established; do not substitute Penteado’s distinct 1968 journal article.

id: W:historia das mulheres no brasil|sao paulo
note: The displaced title and Contexto imprint identify the anthology organized by Mary Del Priore, with text coordination by Carla Bassanezi. LC confirms the 1997 original; 2007 is a later edition. No individual chapter is named.

original_title: A sedução da liberdade: cotidiano e contestação política no final do século XVIII
container: Laura de Mello e Souza (ed.), História da vida privada no Brasil, vol. 1: Cotidiano e vida privada na América portuguesa. São Paulo: Companhia das Letras, 1997, pp. 387–437.
note: Contents identify Jancsó’s chapter. ISBN identifies volume 1, not the chapter; no separate chapter DOI or publisher page established. None of the supplied Jancsó works is its container.

original_title: Organizações e programas ministeriais: regime parlamentar no Império
note: LC record confirms the cited 1962 edition under Javari, Jorge João Dodsworth, barão de. It is the second edition of the compilation first published in 1889 as Organisações e programmas ministeriaes desde 1822 a 1889.

LCCN identifies Villa Rica’s 1991 edition; title and author verified against the LC retrospective. Author is Mário de Andrade (1893–1945), the Brazilian modernist. Supplied candidates belong to the Angolan Mário Pinto de Andrade and do not match.

Only a Rio de Janeiro/Paz e Terra/1988 imprint and the fragment “Janeiro, 1750-” survive. Campos da violência by Silvia Hunold Lara is plausible, but neither its author nor title is actually supplied; its LCCN cannot establish that this is the intended work.

Portuguese translation by Afonso Arinos de Melo Franco, reissued by Itatiaia/Edusp in 1980. LCCN, verified in LC, identifies the same translation’s 1972 Martins/Edusp edition. No graph candidate supplied.

id: W:almeida|as aguas e a cidade de belem do para
original_title: As águas e a cidade de Belém do Pará: história, natureza e cultura material no século XIX
container: Pontifícia Universidade Católica de São Paulo, doctoral thesis in História, 2010, 340 f.
note: University repository item identifies Conceição Maria Rocha de Almeida, the exact title and the 11 June 2010 doctoral thesis. Use the item landing page, not the PDF; no book ISBN is applicable.

LC and CiNii confirm the 1985 Vozes tenth edition. LC’s personal-name entry is Paulo Evaristo Arns as prefacer; the report was prepared under the Arquidiocese de São Paulo. Catalogued_as supplies the catalogue access name, not a claim that Arns alone authored the report.

id: W:marquese|o vale do paraiba escravista e a formacao do mercado mundial do cafe no seculo x|a
original_title: O Vale do Paraíba escravista e a formação do mercado mundial do café no século XIX
container: Keila Grinberg and Ricardo Salles (eds.), O Brasil imperial, vol. II: 1831–1870. Rio de Janeiro: Civilização Brasileira, 2009, pp. 339–383.
note: Chapter by Rafael Marquese and Dale Tomich; the USP programme confirms its container. Publisher and LC 2010313188 confirm the volume ISBN. No separate chapter DOI or publisher page established; none of the supplied Tomich works matches.
Newspaper title occupies the author field; the title is only a place/date fragment. Conflicting years 1892 and 1902, with no article title, named author or exact issue date, cannot identify one work.
